newsitem.title: USA: Duke Oconee S.C. nuke seen back on weekend.
newsitem.headline: Duke Oconee S.C. nuke seen back on weekend.

text.p: Duke Power Co's 846 megawatt Oconee nuclear power unit 3 was expected to return to service over the weekend following a shutdown which began in October, 1996, a company spokesman said Tuesday.
The unit, located in Seneca, S.C., should resume power output on March 1 or 2 but "would not reach full power until sometime next week," said spokesman Rick Zuercher.
Oconee 3 was shut for pipe inspections after a steam pipe burst at the adjacent unit 2 in September, injuring seven workers.

Oconee units 1 and 2, each with a capacity of 846 megawatts, were operating normally at 100 percent of capacity as of early Tuesday morning, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission said in its daily plant status report.
